description: Permanently removes a specific saved Discover query (a configuration for exploring event data) from a Sentry organization. This action requires one of the following scopes: org:admin, org:read, or org:write. The Discover saved queries feature is only available on Business and Enterprise plans.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for deleting a saved Discover query within a Sentry organization.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization to which the Discover query belongs.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

query_id.description: The unique integer identifier of the saved Discover query that you intend to delete.
query_id.title: Query Id

inputSchema.title: DeleteOrganizationDiscoverQueryRequest

name: delete_organization_discover_query

DeleteOrganizationDiscoverQueryResponse.description: Response schema for successful deletion of a Discover query.

message.description: A human-readable message confirming the deletion.
message.title: Message

query_id.description: The ID of the deleted Discover query.
query_id.title: Query Id

success.description: Indicates whether the deletion operation was successful.
success.title: Success
